tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one main action and the active state: selected nav pill, filled buttons, switches, the main progress.

tokens.name: primary-container
tokens.usage: The loud tile of a primary-toned screen, unselected segments, progress tracks.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Second accent: quieter marks, the second series in a chart, a section's own tone.

tokens.name: secondary-container
tokens.usage: Tiles and chips in the secondary tone.

tokens.name: tertiary
tokens.usage: Third accent for contrast moments: avatars, highlighted scores, a calm section.

tokens.name: tertiary-container
tokens.usage: The floating add button, callout cards, icon badges on neutral surfaces.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions. Can also serve as the tone of a red-themed section.

tokens.name: surface-container-low
tokens.usage: Inner discs (centre of a ring), subtle wells.

tokens.name: surface-container-high
tokens.usage: Small icon wells and inputs on cards.

tokens.name: surface-container-highest
tokens.usage: Floating controls: nav bar, round buttons, pills over content.

tokens.name: surface-bright
tokens.usage: Cards, list items and neutral tiles on the screen background.

tokens.name: on-surface-variant
tokens.usage: Secondary text: subtitles, labels under numbers, inactive icons.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Borders of controls in their off state.

tokens.name: outline-variant
tokens.usage: Decorative lines and dots only, never text.

tokens.name: status-good
tokens.usage: A value in its good range. Fixed: it does not follow the colour style.

tokens.name: status-warn
tokens.usage: A value in its middle range. Fixed.

tokens.name: status-bad
tokens.usage: A value in its low range.

tokens.name: illustration-sun
tokens.usage: Warm light in illustrations and scene headers.

tokens.name: illustration-night
tokens.usage: Night skies and dark scene headers; put white text on it.

tokens.name: seed-blue
tokens.usage: Seed of the default style; these tokens are derived from it.

tokens.name: seed-red
tokens.usage: Seed for a red-themed section in a multi-colour style.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Screen title. Deliberately light so the metric below leads.

styles.name: metric-xl
styles.usage: The one number a screen is about. wdth 112, tabular figures.

styles.name: badge-number
styles.usage: A value on a ShapeBadge. wdth 112.

styles.name: metric-l
styles.usage: The value of a tile. wdth 112.

styles.name: metric-m
styles.usage: A number among a few. wdth 112.

styles.name: metric-s
styles.usage: A number among many, e.g. a three-up stat row. wdth 106.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.usage: Under the screen title, in on-surface-variant.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Everything is on track. Nothing needs your attention.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: The one comparison sentence, in the screen's accent.

styles.name: nav-label
styles.usage: Selected nav item: 500→800 and wdth 96→112 as it becomes selected.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between rows of a list group.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Padding inside floating bars, gap between header buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between tiles and grid cells.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen gutter and default card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Text inset from the screen edge, padding of large cards.

tokens.name: radius-small
tokens.usage: Inner corners of segments and grouped list items.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Outer corners of list groups, small tiles, carousel cards.

tokens.name: radius-extra-large-increased
tokens.usage: Large tiles, chart cards, the nav bar.

tokens.name: shadow-floating
tokens.usage: Floating bars and the floating action square.

tokens.name: size-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target; nav items and round buttons.

tokens.name: size-hero-badge
tokens.usage: A ShapeBadge carrying a screen's main value.

tokens.name: size-metric-circle
tokens.usage: The disc cell of a metric grid.

tokens.name: size-badge
tokens.usage: Icon badge leading a list item or tile.
